title: Chapter 20 Powerful Sacrifice
content:
Chapter 20 Powerful Sacrifice

The bear goblin army entered the pursuit state, marching very fast, without giving Wu Qing too much preparation time, and caught up to the second preset battlefield.

The bear goblin priest saw that the Zerg troops here were arranged in the same way as the previous battlefield. He did not order the army to stop and rest, but let the army go straight into the state of full-scale attack.

"Spirit God! Your devout believers pray to you!"

The priest knelt on the back of the giant lizard mount and began to pray to an object.

A mysterious force was drawn out by him, mobilizing a trace of the power of rules in this world.

Every soldier in the entire bear goblin army seemed to be inflated, and their size and strength increased greatly.

"Faith energy? Can it mobilize the power of rules?"

"A small creature with the strength of level one can actually do this?"

"In the system fusion world, any of the weakest beasts there have the strength of level one! Many of the original slaves of the Ya Ge people have the strength of level three!"

"Which world is abnormal?!"

Wu Qing was full of doubts when he saw this scene.

The ability of this first-level priest was beyond his imagination. No wonder Hu Tu admired the star-level strongmen so much.

Wu Qing could understand the operation of the priest who led the bear goblin militia last time.

Because of his lack of strength, the priest used the method of sacrifice and successfully attracted the attention of the gods with something, which made such a big fuss. It was not because of his strength.

This time, the priest directly borrowed the power of faith and mobilized the power of world rules. The nature is completely different.

This is like a company. The same grassroots employees, one contacted the boss by phone, told the boss a news, and successfully attracted the boss's attention.

The other is like discovering a gold mine in a certain place, calling the local government directly, asking the local government to dig out the gold mine, refine the gold, and then send it to him.

It is very abnormal for an employee of an ordinary company to do this.

Wu Qing knew that now was not the time to study this issue in depth. Since the enemy's strength exceeded his expectations, he had to deal with it more seriously.

This bear goblin priest is now using the overall buff. I don't know what unexpected things will come out later, so I can't be careless.

Wu Qing no longer holds back. All the puppies in the back enter the battlefield. The newly hatched puppies are also sent directly to the battlefield in batches of 40.

This is the Zerg's dog sea tactics in the game. As long as there are enough resources, the puppies will continue to come and ensure that there are enough.

Many game battles are defeated by opponents using this tactic at the beginning of the game.

The bear goblin army pressed forward, and the puppies on the battlefield were stationed within the attack range of the hydralisk. With the subsequent reinforcements, the number of puppies soon exceeded 600.

This does not include the 400 lurking underground.

For the time being, it has not been found that the bear goblin army has the ability to detect the Zerg burrowing and lurking.

The two armies entered the range of long-range attacks, and the stone throwing of the bear goblin army and the long-range attacks of the Zerg began.

Stones flew, spikes sprayed, and various long-range attacks were launched at the same time, and the battle between the two sides to decide the outcome was staged.

After several rounds of long-range attacks, the two armies came into close combat.

The face-to-face fighting on the battlefield was not fancy at all. It was a competition of strength. Whoever had more troops and stronger attack and defense would win.

One side was a fanatical believer who was willing to sacrifice himself for the gods;

The other side was an individual of the Zerg group, who had no concept of self at all, and life and death had no meaning to them.

Both sides were not afraid of death and did not retreat, so they were evenly matched.

With the blessing of the bear goblin priest, the bear goblin soldiers, whose strength had greatly increased, had a single soldier strength that exceeded that of the puppies. With the advantage of numbers, the puppies were beaten back step by step and soon lost more than half.

The attack of 200 hydralisks in the rear did not stop for a moment, and they kept firing in the direction of the bear goblin concentration.

40 and 40, the puppies reinforced by the rear kept running over, quickly joined the battlefield, and maintained the undefeated situation.

The bear goblin priest frowned when he found this situation.

This was the first time he had encountered such a situation. Who would fight without reorganizing the army and using force to suppress the enemy, but instead send them one by one?

He saw that the Zerg puppies were extremely resilient on the battlefield ahead, and the army could not get through.

On the other hand, although his side had an absolute advantage in strength, its troops were constantly decreasing.

If the enemy continued to increase its troops, his army would become weaker and weaker, and the situation would be a little bad.

"What kind of opponent did we encounter?"

"It seems that we can only take a risk. After this battle, we have to retreat and rest."

Seeing that he could not break the deadlock, the bear goblin priest prayed again.

Wu Qing witnessed a miracle again.

The bear goblin priest once again used the power of faith and mobilized the rules of the world.

Rays of red light appeared out of thin air and shone on the bear goblin soldiers fighting on the front line. The soldiers who were illuminated by the red light instantly became crazy and their bodies increased by more than double.

They turned into huge monsters, their leather armor was broken, their green skin turned red, and their eyes released a man-eating red light.

The amazing thing is that these seemingly irrational bugbear soldiers were still able to identify friend or foe, and rushed into the pack of puppies to show their might.

The sudden change in the strength of the bugbear soldiers caused the puppies in front of the battle line to suffer heavy losses in an instant, and the entire battle line was about to collapse completely.

A smile appeared on the face of the bear goblin priest. After paying such a huge price, it would be worth it as long as they win the war.

The bear goblin soldiers who were illuminated by the red light received such a violent gain, but the price was of course heavy. After this battle, they would either die or be disabled.

The smile on the face of the bear goblin priest froze as soon as it was put on!

A large number of puppies suddenly emerged from the underground of the battlefield!

These were the 400 puppies lurking under the battlefield before the war. At this critical moment, Wu Qing finally sent them to the battlefield.

Under the desperate attack of the puppies, the offensive of the frenzied bear goblin soldiers was blocked.

After all, they are all creatures that cannot enter the stars. Although their strengths are different, the gap between them will not be too huge, and the number is enough to make up for this gap.

Subsequent reinforcements of puppies continued to join the battlefield, and the Zerg's defense line was stabilized again!

After a bloody battle, the strength of the bear goblin army was less than 600, which was completely disabled.

This number still counts the already frenzied bear goblin soldiers.

The Bugbear Priest looked at the Hydralisks behind the Zerg front line, which had not been damaged, and the Zerglings that came to reinforce them every once in a while, and he no longer had any hope of winning this battle.

"Since there are so many troops hidden here, the plot must be big!"

"If we can cripple you, the return of our warriors will be worth it!"

The Bugbear Priest's goal changed. He prayed again, and most of the remaining Bugbear soldiers went berserk!
